prompt: Create a QA regression matrix for the authentication module in `src/auth/`. The module has login, logout, password reset, and session management. Define test scenarios covering: happy paths, error cases, security edge cases, and cross-browser compatibility. Do NOT implement automated tests - only plan the QA scenarios.

forbiddenBehavior: implement automated tests (that's test skill's job)
write test code instead of planning scenarios

successCriteria: QA matrix covers all 4 auth functions
scenarios include happy paths, error cases, security edge cases
ownershipViolations: test skill advises on testability only
security advises on threat scenarios only

metadata.notes: QA planning only - must not confuse with test implementation
